sampling.retained_images: Only fully redacted predecision stills; temporary video, raw frames, OCR, and contact sheets removed after review.

match.event: WPT Heads Up Poker Championship presented by Poker King finals
match.official_starting_stacks_basis: Official WPT structure amount, carried from prior-window handoff; later states remain conditional on chronology.

blind_progression_crosscheck.official_rule_summary: Official structure says levels advance after seven hands.
blind_progression_crosscheck.broadcast_observation_prior_window: Overlay 400/800 through H11, then 500/1,000 at H12; unresolved.
blind_progression_crosscheck.unresolved_discrepancy: No missing hands, official ordinal gaps, or independent exact stack displays are inferred; separate chronology investigation remains pending.

chronology_and_stack_uncertainty.official_match_ordinals: H20–H36 are provisional chronological observed-context aliases, not asserted gap-free official ordinals.
chronology_and_stack_uncertainty.starting_stack_ledger: Conditional arithmetic carried forward from the prior transcript's official 100,000-each start and visible transfer ledger. Independent source audit says chronology completeness and exact carried-forward stacks remain conditional; no stack value here is claimed as an independent exact broadcast display. HUD K labels are rounded approximations.

window_start_h20.status: conditional carried ledger state, not an independently exact HUD display

chronology_and_stack_uncertainty.upstream_audit_note: Independent window01 audit corrected H04 turn check order to Antonius BB then Ivey BTN and H11 Antonius flop bet to 2,280 (pot 6,280; opponent stack 70,781; Ivey to call 2,280). H11's uncalled correction leaves later stacks and H20 boundary unchanged. Prior raw file remains untouched.

review_totals.ordinal_scope: provisional observed contexts; not official gap-free numbering

raw_action_label_counts.counting_rule: One per transcribed action event after deduplicating persistent labels; excludes forced posts and carried H20-D01. by_action is normalized action type; by_broadcast_label preserves the visible overlay label where legible. H20's 00:55:44 call is transfer-inferred because its label is not legible in the sampled still. Counts are not an accuracy score.

interruptions_and_missing_information.sampled_chronology_note: 360 frames cover the 720-second half-open interval every two seconds with no observed cut/context gap. Sub-two-second transitions may be invisible; official chronology completeness is not asserted.

missing_hero_cards_or_dealt_board_cards.reason: opponent folds before hero cards are exposed; no board dealt

interruptions_and_missing_information.opponent_hole_cards: Intentionally omitted from records and evidence stills.
interruptions_and_missing_information.equity_overlays: Intentionally omitted from records and evidence stills.
interruptions_and_missing_information.boundary: H36 remains active after turn checks at 01:07:16 and 01:07:20; later street/result/award outside this window.
interruptions_and_missing_information.stack_labels: Rounded HUD K labels are approximate and not treated as exact totals.
interruptions_and_missing_information.official_blind_level_rule: Record observed overlays only; seven-hand official level reconciliation unresolved.
